in_marathi.name: Mandira
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mandira हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'mandira' which means a mansion or temple. In Hindu mythology, Mandira is an epithet of the goddess Lakshmi and signifies a prosperous and beautiful dwelling.
